data.description:
Update enforcement-gate.sh to read dso.workflow instead of enforcement.strategy.

## Testing Mode: UPDATE

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh
- tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- tests/hooks/lib/test-enforcement-gate-lib.sh (if it tests _dso_enforcement_gate_check behavior)

## Implementation Change in enforcement-gate.sh
Replace _dso_enforcement_gate_check() body (lines 38-72) with:

```bash
_dso_enforcement_gate_check() {
    local _script_dir _wf
    _script_dir="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)"
    # Find read-config.sh: sibling scripts/ directory
    local _rc_script="$_script_dir/../../scripts/read-config.sh"
    # Config file resolution: honor WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE for test isolation
    if [[ -n "${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE:-}" ]]; then
        _wf=$(WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE="${WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE}" bash "$_rc_script" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")
    else
        _wf=$(bash "$_rc_script" dso.workflow 2>/dev/null || echo "local")
    fi
    if [[ "$_wf" == "ci-pr" ]]; then
        echo "HOOK_GATE: skipped reason=dso.workflow=ci-pr" >&2
        return 0
    fi
    return 1
}
```

## Notes
- Remove "both" strategy branch — dso.workflow is binary (ci-pr or local)
- Update header comments to reference dso.workflow instead of enforcement.strategy
- Keep the guard [[ "${_DSO_ENFORCEMENT_GATE_LOADED:-}" == "1" ]] && return 0
- Keep WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE capture at source time for test isolation

## Test Updates (must FAIL before implementation)
In test-enforcement-gate.sh: update all WORKFLOW_CONFIG_FILE configs that set enforcement.strategy=ci to instead set dso.workflow=ci-pr; update assertions on HOOK_GATE log message to match new "reason=dso.workflow=ci-pr"

## Story DD Coverage
This task contributes to DD1 (zero grep matches for enforcement.strategy in hook files)

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh and tests/hooks/lib/test-enforcement-gate-lib.sh pass
  Verify: bash tests/hooks/test-enforcement-gate.sh
- [ ] grep -q 'enforcement\.strategy' plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh returns non-zero (no functional refs remain; comment refs handled in Task 7)
  Verify: ! grep -q "grep.*enforcement\.strategy\|enforcement\.strategy.*grep\|read-config.*enforcement" plugins/dso/hooks/lib/enforcement-gate.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
